headline: Six a.m. and the lamp still wins.
body: The window shows the same unlit opposite wall. A delivery van passes, then nothing. The notebook page remains blank.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: no color yet above the roofline

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: empty, one wet patch near the drain

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: single warm circle on the desk
